Inkhold — readme
================

This is the plain-text file the demo library shows as "readme". It is long
enough to scroll on a phone, has a few blank lines, a list, one very long
line that has to wrap, and words worth searching for (marmalade, lentils).

Shopping list
-------------

- oat milk
- lentils, the small red ones
- marmalade (the bitter Seville kind)
- a new nib for the Supernote
- batteries for the kitchen scale

Notes from Sunday
-----------------

We talked about moving the bookshelf to the hallway. The hallway is 92 cm
wide at its narrowest, so a 30 cm deep shelf still leaves room to pass.
Measure again before buying anything.

A line that goes on and on without a break, the kind a phone has to wrap because nobody pressed Enter while typing it into a note-taking app at eleven at night: remember to water the basil, call the plumber about the slow drain, and return the library books before Thursday.

Code-ish things keep their spacing:

    name      qty   price
    lentils     2    3.40
    oat milk    4    7.96
    marmalade   1    4.25

Indented by a tab:
	one tab in
		two tabs in

Unicode: café, naïve, Zürich, 東京, emoji 📚 and an em dash — like this.

The end. If you can read this line, the file scrolled all the way down.
